caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a mannequin with a pale beige face featuring painted black eyebrows, outlined eyes, and red lips. The mannequin wears a brown bonnet adorned with a band of small flowers and greenery, including yellow, green, and blue elements, as well as a blue ribbon. The bonnet frames the head closely, and a light blue ribbon is tied around the neck in a bow. The mannequin is dressed in a garment that is dark blue with a peacock-feather-like pattern and is trimmed with black. The background of the image is plain and light beige, with a subtle rectangular border around the central subject.
title: Mannequin
